_comment: PROVENANCE PIN for the vendored copy of ms-codec's hashlock corpus (SPEC_hashlock_H2_device §7.1).
The rows are MEASURED constants (python3 hashlib + openssl kdf) recorded by the H1 plan; never edited by hand.
hashlock/hashlock_test.go fails if sha256 and the file disagree or if any derivation row disagrees with the Go port.
H6 re-vendored this file for the seven qr_text rows SPEC_hashlock_H6 §8.6/§11.2 adds; the format string moved to v0.9
while the FILENAME stayed hashlock-v0.8.json, which is what every reader of it already opens.
hashlock/methodline_h6_test.go pins MethodLine and QRText against those rows, and backup/hashlock_test.go pins the plate against them.

SPEC_hashlock_kinds phase 4 re-vendored this for the three new hash kinds: each derivation row gains *_h_hash256, *_h_ripemd160 and *_h_hash160 (computed in python3 hashlib OUTSIDE ms-codec -- a row generated by the code it tests is not a KAT), and qr_text gains a kind column and three per-kind rows (7 -> 10). The FILENAME still says v0.8, which is what every reader of it opens.
release: ms-codec 0.10.0 (SPEC_hashlock_kinds phase 2, shipped at mnemonic-secret origin/master 9dcd2e0 with no CI bypass). The previous pin was ms-codec 0.9.0 at ffdb77d4. The commit named above is the one that last TOUCHED this file, not the release tip -- re-measured rather than assumed.
format: ms hashlock corpus v0.9 (SPEC_ms_hashlock §8; qr_text rows added by SPEC_hashlock_H6 §8.6/§11.2)
